newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Jakarta stocks seen stable, eye on Sentul.
newsitem.headline: Jakarta stocks seen stable, eye on Sentul.

text.p: Jakarta stocks are seen stable on Tuesday as worries over the rupiah are likely to ease further, while the market focus was seen on newly-listed Bukit Sentul, brokers said.
"Sentiment is likely to improve as the rupiah has largely stabilised after recent turmoil," one broker with a large local brokerage firm said.
The rupiah was traded at 2,575.00/77.00 against the dollar at 0200 GMT compared with 2,575.00/85.00 at the opening.
Brokers said the market focus was seen remaining on property firm Sentul following a 25-percent rise on Monday.
